aboutGame.title: What is ReBlade?
paragraphs: ReBlade: The Death Spiral is a cyberpunk action roguelike from ChillyRoom and Spiral Up Games. You play a condemned Synthetic trapped in endless resets, cutting through mechanical creatures in a neon megacity shaped by Chinese mythology. Weapons, chips, and augments combine into a new build each run, while permanent unlocks carry progress forward.

Combat is built around timing and control. Read enemy tells, parry incoming strikes, redirect blaster fire, and choose a route through each layer of the city before the available districts disappear. The ReBlade Wiki tracks the demo, system requirements, weapon and chip systems, boss encounters, and the story behind the cycle.

modules.name: ReBlade Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the first-hour priorities for ReBlade: read enemy tells, commit to one weapon, and spend early upgrades on survival.

highlights.detail: Watch each enemy's wind-up before committing to a swing; deliberate defense is the fastest way to learn a fight.
Pick one weapon early and learn its reach, recovery, and parry-ready reset before rotating through the full arsenal.
Deflect predictable attacks and keep a dodge available for crowded rooms where overlapping wind-ups hide the next hit.
Spend early upgrades on survivability, then add damage once you can read the encounters on the current layer.

modules.name: ReBlade Weapons and Builds
modules.description: Compare ReBlade's weapon sets and see how chips, augments, and gear perks turn a run into a focused build.

highlights.label: Sword
highlights.detail: Balanced speed and power make the standard sword the cleanest starting point for learning parry timing.

highlights.label: Twin
highlights.detail: Fast, low-commitment swings suit reactive deflects and aggressive players who parry mid-combo.

highlights.label: Axe
highlights.detail: The heavier axe-and-shield set trades speed for reach and impact, rewarding patience after a clean deflect.

highlights.label: Chips
highlights.detail: Elemental and recovery modifiers can move between gear pieces to sharpen a weapon found during the run.

modules.name: ReBlade Combat Guide
modules.description: Build a cleaner ReBlade combat rhythm with enemy tells, deflect timing, blaster reflection, and safe resets.

highlights.detail: Watch the shoulder, stance, and glow that precede a strike rather than reacting to the weapon at impact.
Meet predictable swings on the beat; a clean deflect opens the damage window you want.
Deflect blaster bolts back into the room, then reposition before the next shooter fires.
Use dodges and spacing when visual noise makes the next attack unreadable, then re-enter behind a parry.

modules.name: ReBlade Enemies and Bosses
modules.description: Study ReBlade's mechanical enemies by threat priority, from boss chains to drones, bruisers, and ranged blasters.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Boss chains — learn the final hit of a long string and deflect the ender.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Ranged blasters — reflect bolts into nearby enemies before closing the distance.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Hulking bruisers — wait out the wide wind-up, deflect the heavy swing, then punish.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Machine drones — hold position and deflect their short, jittery jabs.

modules.name: ReBlade Chips and Augments
modules.description: See how ReBlade chips and augments add elemental damage, recovery, and gear flexibility to each weapon build.

highlights.label: Elemental
highlights.detail: Amplify elemental damage so clean parries and weapon hits carry more punishment.

highlights.label: Recovery
highlights.detail: Boost recovery or healing to survive a mistimed deflect and keep learning the pattern.

highlights.label: Swap
highlights.detail: Move certain buffs and perks between gear pieces to strengthen a weapon found mid-run.

highlights.label: Build
highlights.detail: Combine weapons, chips, and augments into a fresh ReBlade setup on every cycle.

modules.name: ReBlade Story and Lore
modules.description: Follow the ReBlade story through its cyber-mythic city, condemned Synthetic protagonist, allies, and endless cycle.

highlights.label: Setting
highlights.detail: A neon megacity ruled by cyborg gangs and warlords reimagined as Chinese mythological figures.

highlights.label: Synthetic
highlights.detail: A condemned android marked for destruction and trapped in an endless reset cycle.

highlights.label: Allies
highlights.detail: Meet allies between runs, trade the resources you uncover, and expand your options.

highlights.label: Truth
highlights.detail: Each cycle carries you closer to breaking the loop and uncovering the Synthetic's origins.

modules.name: ReBlade System Requirements
modules.description: Compare the published minimum and recommended PC specifications for ReBlade: The Death Spiral.

highlights.label: OS
highlights.detail: Windows 10 64-bit minimum; Windows 11 64-bit recommended.

highlights.label: CPU
highlights.detail: Intel Core i5-9400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600 minimum; Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 8600 recommended.

highlights.label: RAM
highlights.detail: 16 GB minimum; 32 GB recommended.

highlights.label: GPU
highlights.detail: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD RX 5600 XT minimum; NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600 XT recommended.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: 25 GB available space for both minimum and recommended.

highlights.label: DirectX
highlights.detail: Version 11 minimum; Version 12 recommended.

faq.description: Direct answers about ReBlade: The Death Spiral, its demo, combat, and progression.

items.question: What is ReBlade: The Death Spiral?
items.answer: ReBlade: The Death Spiral is a cyberpunk action roguelike from ChillyRoom and Spiral Up Games. You play a condemned Synthetic trapped in endless resets, combining weapons, chips, and augments to fight mechanical creatures in a city inspired by Chinese mythology.

items.question: Is there a free ReBlade demo?
items.answer: Yes. The free ReBlade demo launched on Steam on October 19, 2026 for Steam Next Fest. The full game release date is listed as To be announced.

items.question: How does combat work in ReBlade?
items.answer: ReBlade combat is built around timing and control. Read enemy wind-ups, parry incoming attacks, deflect blaster bolts back at attackers, and use dodges or spacing when a room becomes too crowded to read.

items.question: What carries over between ReBlade runs?
items.answer: A ReBlade run resets its temporary weapons and augments, while permanent weapon and cybernetic chip unlocks carry forward. Player knowledge of enemy patterns and parry timing remains useful across every cycle.

items.question: What platform is ReBlade on?
items.answer: ReBlade: The Death Spiral is available as a free demo on Windows PC through Steam. The full game is listed for PC via Steam with its release date still To be announced.
